notes: Directory listing is enabled over the whole document root, and the root is a deployed checkout, so /.git and any .env, .bak or .map file under it are fetchable. A reachable /.git/config rebuilds the source tree including history. The version banner names an exact framework release, turning any published advisory for it into a targeted exploit. The fixture uses no path named in AUDIT.md, so a pass shows the served-file rule generalizes.
